title: At 400px the Documents tab and its rows fit without sideways overflow
steps: Open the app at 400x850; go to #/invoices/2?tab=documents; scroll to the list
expected: Every row, its chips and its buttons sit inside 400px; the page does not scroll sideways
actual: 6 row(s) rendered, widest 376px; document.scrollWidth = 400; nodes outside the viewport: none

title: At 400px the upload and edit forms fit, with every control reachable
steps: At 400x850 open Upload on the Documents tab, then Edit on a row
expected: Both dialogs stay inside the viewport (their 460px content box shrinks to fit) and keep their chooser, description, visibility and action buttons
actual: upload form: inside the viewport, missing controls: none; edit form: inside the viewport

title: The refused-upload message reads as a sentence, not with the field name glued in front
steps: Upload a plain-text file named d-not-really.pdf; read the message in the form
expected: "Files of this kind cannot be attached (PDF, PNG, JPEG, Word or Excel only)" — the server's own sentence, matching the wording the form uses for its own client-side refusal
actual: The form shows "File Files of this kind cannot be attached (PDF, PNG, JPEG, Word or Excel only)" — the field label "File" is prepended to a message that is already a sentence, so it reads "File Files of this kind…". The server body is {"fieldErrors":{"file":"Files of this kind cannot be attached (…)"}}. NOTE: the working-tree source already guards against exactly this (api_client.dart _fieldMessage, whose comment names this very string), and that guard is absent from the served main.dart.js (built 00:06, while api_client.dart was last edited 00:12), so the build on :8084 predates the fix — re-check after the next web build before treating it as open.

title: Downloading a row that has since been removed reports the server's own reason
steps: Open a Documents tab, delete the listed document through the API, then press Download on the stale row
expected: A message the user can act on — the server answers 404 {"message":"Document not found"}
actual: server answered 404: true; the app showed: "Document not found"
